subject: PO tombstone reassignment + SKU line correction for vendor activation
messages:
From: Emily Chu <emily.chu@tidewater.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
Cc: onboarding@tidewater.io
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tidewater activation — provisional PO and onboarding packet

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for walking us through Redwood last week. We're ready to move into procurement and need a provisional PO number plus confirmation of the spend cap for our initial sandbox and pilot usage. I attached our completed onboarding form and a CSV with the requested PO/line structure we received from our FP&A team.

Quick asks:
- Can you provision a PO number we can reference for internal approvals? Ideally something we can map to code 37841 on our side.
- What is the default spend cap for pilot customers and is there a path to request a temporary increase while we run the 6-week POC?
- We realized the CSV has product SKUs that should map to two Redwood billing line items; let us know if anything needs to be renamed.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Chu
Procurement Manager, Tidewater Analytics
attachments: tidewater_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF), provisional_po_37841.csv (CSV)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Chu <emily.chu@tidewater.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tidewater activation — provisional PO and onboarding packet

Emily —

Appreciate the packet. Quick heads-up on process and next steps from Redwood side:

1) Provisional PO: We can issue a provisional PO identifier that Tidewater can reference internally immediately. It will be assigned as a "tombstone" (provisional placeholder) while final PO sequencing is completed by Finance. We typically reserve these for onboarding flows and attach a temporary spend cap.

2) Default pilot spend cap: Standard pilot cap is $12,500 USD for first 30 days. We can process a one-time temporary increase to $25k for the POC if you share the specific usage window and expected token volumes (ballpark). Karthik — can you confirm whether we need finance approval for a $25k pilot bump or if ops can set it?

3) Line items / SKU mapping: I glanced at your CSV — one mismatch: Tidewater SKU TDW-ENG-API should map to Redwood line item "gen.tokens.standard" instead of "gen.tokens.premium". Please see my inline notes on the attached revised sheet (I added a column "redwood_sku").

We'll issue the tombstone PO now and update with final PO and ledger mapping once Finance runs the sequence. Expect the provisional identifier in a follow-up within 2 business hours.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Emily Chu <emily.chu@tidewater.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tidewater activation — provisional PO and onboarding packet

Hey team —

Finance check: ops can set provisional spend caps up to $20,000. For a $25k bump we'll need a one-line email approval from our Sales Director (or a short procurement justification). If Tidewater can confirm expected pilot dates and rough monthly token consumption (or expected invoice frequency), we can fast-track the approval.

Priyom — I'll mark this as "requires director approval" if Emily confirms the $25k target; otherwise I'll set tombstone PO with $12.5k cap.

Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Emily Chu <emily.chu@tidewater.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tidewater activation — provisional PO and onboarding packet

Thanks — we can commit to the $25k temporary cap for the 6-week POC (Jun 14 — Jul 26). Expected peak is ~3M tokens/week, tapering after week 3. Consider this our procurement justification. Also, attached an updated lineitems sheet with corrected internal SKUs; one line (analytics-ensemble) should actually be split across two billing items (inference.pipeline and inference.embed).

Emily
attachments: tidewater_lineitems_v2.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Chu <emily.chu@tidewater.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Tidewater activation — provisional PO and onboarding packet

Emily —

All set: we've issued tombstone PO REF-RW-37841-T (provisional) and applied a temporary spend cap of $25,000 for the window 2026-06-14 through 2026-07-26. Notes:

- Final PO sequencing: Finance will replace the tombstone with canonical PO RW-2026-37841 within 3 business days; we'll send the official ledger assignment then.
- Line items: Per your revised sheet, we've split "analytics-ensemble" into two Redwood billing lines: inference.pipeline (70%) and inference.embed (30%). The attached CSV export shows the new mapping.
- Attachments & links: I uploaded the final mapping and provisional PO to the HubSpot deal and the onboarding Drive folder: https://hubspot.example/deal/TDW-2026-0419, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AexampleOnboarding

Please confirm you see REF-RW-37841-T on your internal systems and that the split matches FP&A expectations. If everything looks good I'll mark the activation ticket resolved.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Procurement Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: provisional_po_37841.csv (CSV)
